Understanding St. Clair County’s Tax Foreclosure Sales

All auctions are conducted online at Tax-Sale.info. This site offers video guides to make the process easier and outlines the steps for fully online auctions.

To participate, you must:

  1. Register on the auction site.
  2. Place a $1,000 hold on a credit card as a deposit.
  3. Bidding opens 30 days prior to the auction and ends at 7:00 p.m. on the auction day.
  4. If you are the highest bidder, you will be notified by email about payment and required notarized paperwork.

The minimum bid includes all back taxes, fees, and costs. There are no sales below this amount. Auctions have two phases:

  • Advance Bidding: You can set and adjust your maximum bid without seeing other bids.
  • Active Bidding: You can see and react to current high bids.

Manual bidding is available for those without internet access.

Steps to Get Started

Research and Understand Local Laws: It’s crucial to know the legal framework in St. Clair County.

Visit the Local Treasurer’s Website: Find all necessary tax sale information here.

Check the Auction Site: Visit Tax-Sale.info for property listings and auction details.

Read the Auction Details: Make sure you understand the sale schedule, parcel inquiries, and other essential details.

Contact the County Office: For additional inquiries, contact the Treasurer’s Office at (810) 989-6915.

Pro Tips

  • Prepare Early: Register and review auction properties in advance to make informed bids.
  • Set a Budget: Know your maximum bid and stick to it to avoid overbidding.
  • Use Online Resources: Watch video guides on the auction site to familiarize yourself with the process.

Attractions and Economic Highlights of St. Clair County

Popular Attractions: Explore parks, theatres, and historic sites. Transportation Infrastructure: Enjoy well-developed roads, rails, and nearby airports. Economic Development: The county boasts growth in sectors like agriculture, technology, and manufacturing. Community Appeal: Engage in outdoor recreational activities, entertainment options, and eco-tourism opportunities.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Q: What is the deposit required for bidding?
A: A $1,000 hold on a credit card is required as a deposit.

Q: When do auctions typically end?
A: Auctions end at 7:00 p.m. on the designated auction day.

Q: Can I participate without internet access?
A: Yes, manual bidding options are available for those without internet access.

Q: Where can I find the list of auction properties?
A: Auction properties are listed on Tax-Sale.info.
